description: This file defines a base class for structured model pruning in PyTorch, including pattern matching for pruning modules like Linear, Conv2d, and LSTM, and methods for model configuration and pruning execution.

classes.name: BaseStructuredSparsifier
classes.description: Abstract base class for structured pruning, extending BaseSparsifier, with methods for model configuration, pattern matching, and pruning.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the BaseStructuredSparsifier with default patterns for pruning.

methods.name: make_config_from_model
methods.description: Creates pruning configuration from a given model, supporting specific modules.

methods.name: _prepare
methods.description: Attaches parameterizations and bias hooks to model modules based on configuration.

methods.name: prune
methods.description: Performs symbolic tracing of the model, matches patterns, applies pruning functions, and verifies parametrizations.
